text_en: Therefore let us go on toward perfection, leaving behind the basic teaching about Christ, and not laying again the foundation: repentance from dead works and faith toward God,
text_cn: 因此，让我们搁下论基督的初级教理，而努力向成全的课程迈进；不必再树立基础，就是讲论悔改、死亡的行为、信赖天主、

text_en: instruction about baptisms, laying on of hands, resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.
text_cn: 及各种洗礼、覆手、死者复活和永远审判的道理。

text_en: And we will do this, if God permits.
text_cn: 如果天主准许，我们就这样去作。

text_en: For it is impossible to restore again to repentance those who have once been enlightened, and have tasted the heavenly gift, and have shared in the Holy Spirit,
text_cn: 的确，那些曾一次被光照，尝过天上的恩赐，成了有分于圣神，

text_en: and have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the age to come,
text_cn: 并尝过天主甘美的言语，及未来世代德能的人，

text_en: and then have fallen away, since on their own they are crucifying again the Son of God and are holding him up to contempt.
text_cn: 如果背弃了正道，再叫他们自新悔改，是不可能的，因为他们亲自又把天主子钉在十字架上，公开加以凌辱。

text_en: Ground that drinks up the rain falling on it repeatedly, and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is cultivated, receives a blessing from God.
text_cn: 就如一块田地，时有雨水降于其上，时受润泽：若出产有益于那种植者的蔬菜，就必蒙受天主的祝福；

text_en: But if it produces thorns and thistles, it is worthless and on the verge of being cursed; its end is to be burned over.
text_cn: 但若生出荆棘蒺(jí)藜(lí)来，就必被废弃，必要受诅咒，它的结局就是焚烧。

text_en: Even though we speak in this way, beloved, we are confident of better things in your case, things that belong to salvation.
text_cn: 可是，亲爱的诸位！我们虽这样说，但对你们，我们确信你们将有更好的表现，更近于救恩，

text_en: For God is not unjust; he will not overlook your work and the love that you showed for his sake in serving the saints, as you still do.
text_cn: 因为天主不是不公义的，甚至于忘掉了你们的善工和爱德，即你们为了他的名，在过去和现在，在服事圣徒的事上所表现的爱德。

text_en: And we want each one of you to show the same diligence so as to realize the full assurance of hope to the very end,
text_cn: 我们只愿你们每一位表现同样的热心，以达成你们的希望，一直到底。

text_en: so that you may not become sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
text_cn: 这样，你们不但不会懈怠，而且还会效法那些因信德和耐心而继承恩许的人。

text_en: When God made a promise to Abraham, because he had no one greater by whom to swear, he swore by himself,
text_cn: 当天主应许亚巴郎的时候，因为没有一个比天主大而能指着起誓的，就指着自己起誓，

text_en: saying, “I will surely bless you and multiply you. ”
text_cn: 说：“我必多多祝福你，使你的后裔繁多。”

text_en: And thus Abraham, having patiently endured, obtained the promise.
text_cn: 这样亚巴郎因耐心等待，而获得了恩许。

text_en: Human beings, of course, swear by someone greater than themselves, and an oath given as confirmation puts an end to all dispute.
text_cn: 人都是指着比自己大的起誓；以起誓作担保，了结一切争端。

text_en: In the same way, when God desired to show even more clearly to the heirs of the promise the unchangeable character of his purpose, he guaranteed it by an oath,
text_cn: 为此天主愿意向继承恩许的人，充分显示自己不可更改的旨意，就以起誓来自作担保，

text_en: so that through two unchangeable things, in which it is impossible that God would prove false, we who have taken refuge might be strongly encouraged to seize the hope set before us.
text_cn: 好叫我们这些寻求避难所的人，因这两种不可更改的事──在这些事上天主决不会撒谎──得到一种强有力的鼓励，去抓住那摆在目前的希望。

text_en: We have this hope, a sure and steadfast anchor of the soul, a hope that enters the inner shrine behind the curtain,
text_cn: 我们拿这希望，当作灵魂的安全而又坚固的锚，深深地抛入帐幔的内部。

text_en: where Jesus, a forerunner on our behalf, has entered, having become a high priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek.
text_cn: 作前驱的耶稣已为我们进入了那帐幔内部，按照默基瑟德品位做了永远的大司祭。
